stem: Which of the following explains how water undergoes a change of state in one stage of the water cycle in order to move from the ocean's surface into the air?

options.label: F
options.text: Liquid water that is heated by the sun becomes a gas and rises.

options.label: G
options.text: Gaseous water rises as it is cooled by the ocean.

options.label: H
options.text: Liquid water that is heated by the sun condenses into rain.

options.label: J
options.text: Gaseous water collects in drops of fog above the ocean’s surface.
